, when expert supervision is available but the expert has privileged information, it is better to use imitation learning to learn a good initial policy and then switch to reinforcement learning.
imitation learning is not necessarily the best approach to learning from an expert, and that a more nuanced combination of imitation and reinforcement learning is needed.
